persona: FMCG senior sales officer ready to become area sales manager
resumeText:
Rohit Yadav | Lucknow | rohit.yadav@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Sales Officer, Ganga Consumer Products Ltd, Lucknow (2021 - present)
- Appointed three new distributors in Barabanki and Sitapur and reviewed distributor ROI every quarter.
- Drive primary and secondary sales across 2,400 general trade outlets in six towns.
- Planned new beats and territory expansion into 40 rural markets.
- Lead a team of five territory sales executives and coach them on outlet calls.
- Prepare monthly Excel reports of target vs achievement by distributor and town.
- Present the monthly territory review to the regional sales manager.
- Use the Bizom app for distributor orders and team attendance.

Sales Officer, Awadh Snacks Pvt Ltd, Kanpur (2018 - 2021)
- Grew numeric distribution in Kanpur city from 900 to 1,500 outlets.
- Handled retailer complaints and stock rotation with the distributor.

EDUCATION
BBA, Lucknow University, 2018

SKILLS
Distributor collections, MS Excel, Team handling
